newsitem.title: USA: Courier Corp sees competitive '97 market.
newsitem.headline: Courier Corp sees competitive '97 market.

text.p: Courier Corp said on Thursday it expects a competitive market in 1997, but its earnings will benefit from steps taken to cut costs.
"We are optimistic about 1997 even though we expect market conditions to remain highly competitive," chairman and chief executive officer James Conway III said in a statement.

Conway cited steps taken to consolidate facilities and boost productivity as keys to anticipated higher earnings in 1997. Courier prepares, produces and stores information in books, online services and CD-Roms.
